verdict.rationale: Passkey support is a fair question for an authenticator and password manager, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard code generation (2FAS Auth) and password, card and note storage with autofill (2FAS Pass). Nothing in the pack mentions storing passkeys or signing in with them.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes
